_see: references/subagents.md (dispatch protocol) and references/harness-portability.md (evidence tiers). scripts/test-agent-adapters.sh checks this file against the tree and the installers.

ownership.marker_form: An HTML comment that is the LAST non-blank line of every adapter file the installer writes: `<!-- wgm-role-agent-adapter host=<id> source=<canonical path> version=<manifest_version> ... -->`. A trailing CR and trailing blank lines are tolerated, so a CRLF rewrite cannot hide it.
ownership.marker_position: terminal: the marker must be the file's last non-blank line. A file that quotes the token in prose, or buries a marker above its own trailing text, is not wgm's and is never refreshed, pruned, or deleted.
ownership.marker_host_scope: per host: a file belongs to wgm only for the host named in `host=`, and only when `source=` is the canonical path for that exact basename. Claude never claims a `.agent.md` file, so a shared or symlinked Copilot/Claude agent directory can never be cross-refreshed, cross-pruned, or cross-deleted.
ownership.rule: Ownership is proved by the marker's position, host, and canonical source — never inferred from a matching file name, and never from the token appearing somewhere in the file. Files that fail that test are never refreshed, pruned, or deleted, and are never listed in the receipt; only --force / -Force may replace one, and it stamps and records what it replaced with this host's marker. The receipt is an atomically written, host-stamped index of the last install (basenames only, host name rules enforced, CRLF tolerated) that narrows where wgm looks; the marker is what authorises a delete, so a lost, partial, or other-host receipt costs recovery, not safety.

canonical.notes: The Copilot custom-agent format is wgm's canonical role definition. Every other host adapter is derived from it by scripts/sync-agent-adapters.sh; nothing else is hand-authored.

hosts.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
hosts.notes: Canonical format, installed verbatim. The user-scope path is the one an install has to create; the project-scope path is the repository directory Copilot already scans, which is why wgm's own checkout is never installed onto itself.

hosts.name: Claude Code
hosts.notes: Written to Claude Code's documented subagent format (frontmatter name/description, body as the system prompt, slug identifiers). Expected, not Verified: wgm has never dispatched these files from a live Claude Code run, so the translation stays conservative — name, description, and the canonical body, no host-specific tool or model keys.

hosts.name: Generic .agents / Agent Skills client
hosts.notes: The Agent Skills standard defines skills, not subagents, so there is no directory to install a role definition into and wgm invents none. These clients get the portable skill plus the explicit fallback: scripts/audit.sh for the docs-audit swarm, and inline sequential review passes with dissent preserved (references/subagents.md).

fallback.when: The host has no subagent primitive, or wgm ships no adapter for its format.
fallback.docs_audit: scripts/audit.sh — dispatches all five docs-audit roles through the host's documented headless command.
fallback.review: Run the two review passes inline and sequentially in one context and record that independence was weaker, as references/subagents.md prescribes.
fallback.notes: A missing adapter is a named degradation with a named fallback, never a claim that wgm does not run there.
